normalization: CRLF to LF; trim outer whitespace only; preserve all internal text, Unicode, order and punctuation

cases.claim: WinAnsi accented Latin characters retain exact codepoints
Explicit Type0 ToUnicode mappings preserve Greek, Cyrillic and CJK in authored line order
Page and positioned line order, numeric footers and literal markup survive plain extraction
Nested Form XObjects and distinct positioned uses retain text and multiplicity
A leaf page without Resources uses inherited page-tree Form resources
Simple ASCII AcroForm text fields retain qualified field names and values
Existing Tr=3 text is extracted alongside visible text; no OCR is performed
An image-only page supplies no text and cannot fabricate metadata or OCR output
Text wholly outside the page CropBox is excluded
A valid blank page is empty, distinct from a parser error
Non-PDF bytes fail before source acceptance
An unfinished catalog with no usable pages fails before source acceptance
A corrupt later content stream rejects the document instead of returning a successful first-page prefix

unsupported_claims: OCR recognition or accuracy from raster pixels
General multilingual font rendering, right-to-left bidi or complex-script shaping
Arbitrary reading order for columns, tables, charts, rotated layouts or scanned pages
General AcroForm, XFA, JavaScript, encrypted/password-protected or signature support
All malformed PDF, resource-exhaustion, decompression-limit or parser-security cases
Signed HTTP/MCP authentication, installed artifact fidelity or full worker/publication completion
Model extraction quality, promoted facts, embeddings, semantic retrieval or source erasure
